question: Should OpenClaw accept this publisher-feed signed projection contract now, or wait until the ClawHub producers and RFC finalize the exact wire and trust semantics?
rationale: These exported payload types and strict acceptance rules define what future OpenClaw discovery code will trust; tests cannot decide the permanent cross-repository security contract or landing sequence.

options.title: Finalize Producers Then Align
options.body: Keep the draft open until the RFC and producer PRs settle, then update the decoders and add producer-generated interoperability proof.

options.title: Approve This Contract Now
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally freeze these payload types and validation rules as the contract that the ClawHub producers must follow.

options.title: Park The Consumer Slice
options.body: Leave the draft paused until the planned pagination and atomic-application consumer can be reviewed with the full end-to-end boundary.

recommendation.title: Finalize Producers Then Align
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open until the RFC and producer PRs settle, then update the decoders and add producer-generated interoperability proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already reviewing the paired producer trust boundary and have recent history repairing the OpenClaw verifier stack.
